Lumeria (YC S26) is eliminating the guessing in skincare. The Lumoscope is a camera that clips onto your phone and shows you what is happening under your skin. Three lights. One clip. Press it to your skin, and you see what a mirror can't: a breakout building days before it surfaces, and sun damage hiding under skin that looks fine. Every scan is scored: hydration, redness, texture, pores. Today, people copy routines that worked for someone else's skin and hope theirs is average. It never is. Lumi, the coach in the app, reads your scan history, connects flare-ups to causes you would never suspect, and matches products to your data instead of a population average. Preorders are open at the $199 founding price until August 16, shipping Sep-Oct. https://lumeria.skin Congrats on the launch, Maryanne Alhallak and Anthea Guo ! 🚀 https://lnkd.in/gzQ9BJPw
